    • All You Can Sweet

    An evening full of chocolate, sugar and moments of happiness awaits you – that's All You Can Sweet! 🍭

    On 13 November, you'll have the opportunity to enjoy as many sweets as you like for CHF 5.

    Look forward to waffles, crêpes, tiramisu, crumble and chocolate mousse – most of which are vegan or have a vegan option. Plus lots of little treats to snack on. 🍫

    Mulled wine, punch and hot chocolate will also ensure the perfect feel-good atmosphere – all as sweet and warm as the evening itself, of course. ✨

    And if you feel like helping with the baking or preparation, you are of course also very welcome to come along as a helper!

    • Jane Street “Get to Know Us” Panel Talk

    Join Jane Street for a "Get to Know Us" Info Session at ETH!

    Wednesday, 5th November at 4:30pm CET Location: HG D1.1, ETH Central Campus

    We’re currently looking for individuals with a passion for innovation and collaboration to join our team. Join us to hear from Streeters in Quantitative Trading, Software Engineering, and Strategy and Product and learn about their roles and experience at Jane Street! Following an introduction to Jane Street, our opportunities, and our recruiting process, the panel will be student-driven - so bring your questions! "Get to Know Us" is an opportunity to hear from Jane Streeters from our London office. This event complements our video series of the same name. Following an introduction to Jane Street, our opportunities, and our recruiting process, the conversation will be student-driven - so bring your questions!

    If you are interested in learning more about working and interning at Jane Street, please join us. We hope to meet intellectually curious problem solvers - you don't need experience in finance to work at Jane Street.

    At Jane Street, we love food and swag! So you can expect there to be both here too. Please sign up here by EOD Monday, 3rd November if you're interested in attending!

    More ETH Events!

    Tech Talk

    Tuesday, 4th November @ 6:15pm CET In this Tech Talk, Michal - a software engineer at Jane Street, shares his expertise on reducing jitter - deviations from mean input processing times - in low-latency systems.
